pairs.subject: test-harness
pairs.evidence: scripts/sync-desktop-facts.mjs:24 The desktop-facts snapshot that rings.test.ts and desktopFacts.test.ts assert against is a copy of another repo's sources. Its only re-check passes as 'skipped' wherever no ../personas checkout exists, and that includes every CI runner. So nothing re-certifies the copy against the live desktop, and the suite stays green while the desktop drifts.

techniques.evidence: scripts/sync-desktop-facts.mjs:24 The snapshot of an external system has no live lane. CI's drift check skips green, so a recorded suite has stopped testing the world.
